question.text: In a uniform magnetic field, the magnetic needle has a magnetic moment <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>9</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>85</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> and moment of inertia <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>.</mo></math> If it performs <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn></math> complete oscillations in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn></math> seconds then the magnitude of the magnetic field is ____<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>mT</mi></math>  [Take <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> as <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="]" open=""><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>85</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>
